planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno. Only the explicitly wired PWM output D9 from the requirements is represented as a program-owned port.

Serial receive uses one integer input (0..255) at 9600 baud with framing assumption line_or_idle and idle_timeout_ms=20 per provided configuration; invalid/out-of-range frames produce no valid event (catalog default).
Control logic (mapping serial value 0..255 to PWM duty for D9, and how often the PWM updates after a valid serial step) belongs in the SysML model; this proposal only registers the ports.
No serial reporting is specified in the requirements, so serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED brightness set from serial input (0..255 mapped to PWM duty)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Received number 0..255 to set D9 PWM LED brightness

interfaces.name: io_1_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise
